title: Independent MSP expectation ledger (hand-derived, Stage 2, before any Python)
derivation: Every expected value below was worked by hand from CMS Pub. 100-05 Ch. 5 sections 40.8-40.8.3 (docs/rules.md, docs/cms-example-3.md) or from the README interface contract. No value was copied from COBOL output, docs/evidence/, or fixtures/expected.json.
units: integer cents; inputs order [charges C, gross G, primary P, deductible D, coinsurance K, contract A or null, full flag]
formula: If full=Y: 0. Else B = A if present else C; T = D + K; payment = lowest of (G-P, G-T, B-P, B-T), floored at 0 (s40.8.2, s40.8.3 A).

sources.S40.8: Pub. 100-05 Ch. 5 s40.8, PDF p. 78: no Medicare payment when the primary payment is accepted or required as payment in full
sources.S40.8.2: Pub. 100-05 Ch. 5 s40.8.2, PDF pp. 79-80: four limits; lower amount the provider is obligated to accept replaces charges
sources.S40.8.3A: Pub. 100-05 Ch. 5 s40.8.3 A, PDF pp. 80-81: prospective formula, lowest of the four limits
sources.EX1: Pub. 100-05 Ch. 5 s40.8.3 Example 1, PDF p. 82
sources.EX3: Pub. 100-05 Ch. 5 s40.8.3 Example 3, PDF pp. 83-84 (docs/cms-example-3.md)
sources.README: README.md 'Architecture and interfaces' (demo interface contract, not CMS policy)
sources.RULES-DEMO: docs/rules.md 'Simplifications and demo decisions' (demo interface decisions, not CMS policy)

base_valid_record.note: Used by rejection cases; if valid it would pay min(80000,100000) - max(5000,10000) = 70000

policy_cases.arithmetic: B=A=1,300,000 (OTAF replaces charges). T=155,600. G-P=150,000; G-T=1,244,400; B-P=50,000; B-T=1,144,400. Lowest=50,000 ($500). $1,556 deductible is a historical example input.
Counterfactual: same inputs with no OTAF, so B=C=1,500,000. G-P=150,000; G-T=1,244,400; B-P=250,000; B-T=1,344,400. Lowest=150,000 ($1,500): $1,000 more than CMS-EX3.
Same as CMS-EX3 but the primary payment itself was accepted as payment in full: s40.8 gives no Medicare payment.
OTAF one cent lower than Example 3. B=1,299,999. B-P=49,999 is lowest (G-P=150,000; G-T=1,244,400; B-T=1,144,399).
G-P=30,000; G-T=70,000; C-P=50,000; C-T=90,000. Gross minus primary controls: 30,000.
T=30,000+5,000=35,000. G-P=70,000; G-T=45,000; C-P=90,000; C-T=65,000. Gross minus deductions controls: 45,000. Deductible and coinsurance are summed.
Gross exceeds charges. G-P=40,000; G-T=70,000; C-P=20,000; C-T=50,000. Charges minus primary controls: 20,000.
G-P=70,000; G-T=50,000; C-P=50,000; C-T=30,000. Charges minus deductions controls: 30,000.
OTAF with deductions controlling. B=A=50,000; T=30,000. G-P=85,000; G-T=60,000; B-P=45,000; B-T=20,000. Lowest=20,000.
G=C and P=T, so all four limits are 30,000. Payment 30,000.
G=C. G-P=C-P=30,000 tie for lowest; G-T=C-T=45,000. Payment 30,000.
P=T=15,000. G-P=G-T=35,000 tie for lowest; C-P=C-T=75,000. Payment 35,000.
Primary one cent below the 100,000 cap. G-P=C-P=1; G-T=C-T=100,000. Payment 1 cent.
Primary equals min(G,C)=100,000: G-P=0, so no payment (s40.8: primary equals charges/gross). Reason precedence is a demo decision.
Primary 90,000 exceeds gross 80,000: G-P=-10,000, floored to 0.
T=99,999, one cent below the cap. G-P=100,000; G-T=1; C-P=100,000; C-T=1. Payment 1 cent.
T=60,000+40,000=100,000 equals the cap: G-T=0. ZERO because deductions reach the cap.
T=100,001 is one cent above the cap: G-T=-1, floored to 0.
B=A=50,001, one cent above the primary. B-P=1 is lowest (G-P=50,000; G-T=100,000; B-T=50,001).
OTAF equals the primary: B-P=0. Primary reaches the OTAF cap.
No primary payment. G-P=80,000; G-T=70,000; C-P=100,000; C-T=90,000. Payment 70,000.
full=Y while primary and deductions both exceed the cap. Demo precedence puts payment in full first. Payment 0.
Primary (90,000) and deductions (95,000) both reach the 80,000 cap. Demo precedence: PRIMARY_AT_CAP before DEDUCTIONS_AT_CAP.
All limits are 9,999,999,999. Payment is the per-record maximum, 9,999,999,999.
T=19,999,999,998 (11 digits, must not overflow) exceeds the cap. G-T=-9,999,999,999, floored to 0.
Maximum primary equals the maximum cap: G-P=0.

interface_cases.arithmetic: Cap=min(0,0)=0 and P=0 >= 0, so the primary-at-cap reason applies first. Valid zero, not malformed.
An explicit zero contract is present and gives a zero cap. B=0, P=0 >= 0. Valid zero.
A contract equal to charges is allowed. B=50,000. G-P=50,000; G-T=60,000; B-P=40,000; B-T=50,000. Payment 40,000.
12-character ID using every allowed class. Base record pays 70,000.
72 bytes is not 73: BAD_LENGTH with provisional ID @+record number.
74 bytes (an unsupported extra field): BAD_LENGTH.
A blank physical line is a record, not EOF: BAD_LENGTH.
Precedence: length is checked before ID.
An absent (all-space) ID: BAD_ID.
Lowercase letters are not allowed: BAD_ID.
Embedded space; padding may only be trailing: BAD_ID.
The ID must be left-justified; a leading space then a character: BAD_ID.
@ is reserved and not an allowed input character: BAD_ID, so it cannot spoof a provisional ID.
Punctuation other than - and _: BAD_ID.
Precedence: ID is checked before amounts.
A signed field is unsupported: BAD_AMOUNT (real ID kept).
Space in a numeric field: BAD_AMOUNT.
Decimal point / fractional cents: BAD_AMOUNT.
Underscore digit separator: BAD_AMOUNT.
Non-digit coinsurance: BAD_AMOUNT.
Arabic-Indic digit U+0663 (2 UTF-8 bytes) replaces two ASCII digits; the record is still 73 bytes. Not ASCII digits: BAD_AMOUNT.
Negative amount is unsupported: BAD_AMOUNT.
Contract is neither the exact absent sentinel nor all digits. A malformed contract is BAD_AMOUNT, not BAD_CONTRACT.
Spaces do not mean absent (no missing field defaults): BAD_AMOUNT.
Precedence: numeric failure before contract range (200,000 > 100,000) and flag.
Contract one cent above charges: BAD_CONTRACT.
Precedence: contract range before flag.
The flag must be exactly Y or N: BAD_FLAG.
A missing flag does not default: BAD_FLAG.
Validation precedes payment evaluation: an all-zero record with a bad flag is INVALID, not a valid zero.
